sections.title: My Take
sections.content:
Optimize today for momentum. You have enough surface area (dailies + externals) that sloppy transitions will cost you.

  • Demos: make it about their workflow; lock a next step.
  • Internal: one decision per daily, not a status dump.
  • Partnerships: push toward scoped pilots.
